causal_ordering.prediction_time: one minute after the completed reclaim bar opens
causal_ordering.opening_low_sweep: must occur after the completed opening range and before a later reclaim bar

verified_behaviors: gap-down reclaim uses explicit prior completed daily context
opening-low reclaim requires completed range then sweep then later reclaim
future bar mutations cannot change an already-issued opportunity
session reconstruction retains only the first event per mode
invalid daily context and incomplete M1 sequences fail closed
fills above the chase limit are unfilled
same-bar target and stop touches are losses
a cost-negative target touch is not strict success
missing entry or outcome bars never become wins
bars after the frozen exit window cannot change a resolved outcome
expired entries and contract mismatches are explicit
corrections: Milestone 2 added a necessary-condition prefilter to session reconstruction so flat minutes are not repeatedly revalidated. The definitive opportunities_at detector is unchanged, and a parameterized regression test proves optimized reconstruction exactly matches exhaustive minute-by-minute detection for gap-reclaim, opening-low-sweep-reclaim, and no-signal sessions.

decision.reason: Milestone 1 implements and tests causal opportunity and outcome mechanics only. No real OSR dataset, selector, accuracy result, or after-cost aggregate exists yet.
